beats.say: How does an agent decide what to do next? Many use a pattern called ReAct, short for reason and act.
The model thinks about the situation, picks an action, reads the observation, and thinks again, until it can answer.

beats.text: Reasoning out loud helps it plan.
beats.say: Writing out its reasoning before each action helps the model plan, and gives you a readable trace to debug.

beats.text: Always cap the number of steps.
beats.say: The loop ends when the model decides it has the answer. Always add a maximum number of steps, as a safety net.
Typical failures: repeating the same action, inventing tool results, or never deciding to stop. Detect repeats, and cap the steps.
